notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 61-year-old female admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.83, creatinine 0.74-0.8, hemoglobin 10.4-12.1, platelets 288-292, sodium 141, wbc 5.5-6; vitals dbp 68-74, heart_rate 84-88, map 89-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 127-132, spo2 97-99, temp 37-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: EGD: bleeding duodenal ulcer, treated with endoscopic clips; Pantoprazole 80 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.75-0.79, hemoglobin 9.3-10.2, platelets 282-289, sodium 140-141, wbc 5.2-5.8; vitals dbp 69-74, heart_rate 84-89, map 88-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 127-133, spo2 97-98, temp 37.1-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Transfuse 1 unit packed red blood cells
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 61-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
